name: One Hour One Life
author: peter.game.servers@gmail.com
description:
Dedicated server for One Hour One Life
http://onehouronelife.com/

install.script:
# Update
apt update
apt install -y build-essential git

# Create Server folder
mkdir -p /mnt/server/
cd /mnt/server/

# Clone the server builder
curl -o serverPullAndBuildLinux.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasonrohrer/OneLife/master/server/installYourOwnServer/serverPullAndBuildLinux.sh

# Run it
chmod +x serverPullAndBuildLinux.sh
./serverPullAndBuildLinux.sh

echo -e "Install Complete"
